title: CorrectCast: Selective Multimodal Context for Scale-Aware Residual Correction in Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.22178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting models suffer from errors in intensity, location, and spatial structure. Addressing these errors by retraining nowcaster backbones can be computationally expensive and requires architecture-specific modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose CorrectCast, a decoupled residual correction framework that refines completed nowcasts while keeping the base nowcaster frozen. By operating on predicted precipitation fields, CorrectCast requires training only a lightweight corrector, reducing computational overhead while providing a unified correction interface across different nowcasting models. Conditioned on the base nowcast and historical quantitative precipitation estimation (QPE) and precipitable water vapor (PWV) observations, the corrector selects multimodal context and employs scale-aware modulation to estimate residual corrections. translated_title: CorrectCast：面向降水临近预报中尺度感知残差校正的选择性多模态上下文
translated_abstract: 降水临近预报模型在强度、位置和空间结构方面存在误差。通过重新训练临近预报主干网络来解决这些误差可能计算成本高昂，且需要针对特定架构的修改。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了CorrectCast，这是一个解耦的残差校正框架，能够在保持基础临近预报模型冻结的同时对已生成的临近预报结果进行精细化改进。通过在预测的降水场上进行操作，CorrectCast只需训练一个轻量级的校正器，从而降低了计算开销，同时为不同的临近预报模型提供统一的校正接口。以基础临近预报以及历史定量降水估计（QPE）和可降水量（PWV）观测为条件，校正器选择多模态上下文并采用尺度感知调制来估计残差校正。在密西西比河流域（MRB）和美国本土（CO
tldr: CorrectCast提出了一种解耦的残差校正框架，在冻结基础临近预报模型的前提下仅训练轻量级校正器，利用选择性多模态上下文（QPE与PWV观测）和尺度感知调制，以统一的接口校正不同临近预报模型的强度、位置和空间结构误差。
en_tdlr: CorrectCast is a decoupled residual correction framework that keeps the base nowcaster frozen and trains only a lightweight corrector, using selective multimodal context (QPE and PWV observations) with scale-aware modulation to uniformly correct intensity, location, and spatial structure errors across different nowcasting models.
